N Prayer :- Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of Constitution of for a Writ of Certiorari, calling for records pursuant to the impu passed by the 4th Respondent vide proceedings dated 11.01.2019 No93/2018/A1 and quash the same. For Petitioner : Mr. Jim Raj Milton For Respondents : Mr. R. Venkatesh Government Advocate
texts.arguments: 2. When it is pointed out by the Learned Government Advocate appearing for the Respondents that a remedy in the nature of statutory appeal has been provided under Section 70 of the Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006, to challenge the order impugned in this Writ Petition, which is also specifically mentioned therein, Learned Counsel for the Petitioner seeks permission of this Court to withdraw this Writ Petition with liberty to resort to the same and he has made and endorsement to that effect, which is recorded.
texts.petitioner_arguments: 2. When it is pointed out by the Learned Government Advocate appearing for the Respondents that a remedy in the nature of statutory appeal has been provided under Section 70 of the Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006, to challenge the order impugned in this Writ Petition, which is also specifically mentioned therein, Learned Counsel for the Petitioner seeks permission of this Court to withdraw this Writ Petition with liberty to resort to the same and he has made and endorsement to that effect, which is recorded.
